name: MK5-L1
description: MK5-L1 was a black L-1g general purpose droid that was forced to work as the landing-pad operations droid in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 10 BBY, MK5-L1 was freed from slavery when its restraining bolt was removed during a slave revolt in the mines started by the droid L3-37.
